heading: Today
text: Morning clouds, with scattered snow showers through the northern mountains, flurries in the valleys and southern mountains, giving way to periods of sun in the mountains, and mostly sunny in the valleys.  Windy and cold.  Highs in the 30s to near 40 north, 40 to 45 through the Champlain Valley and south.  Northwest winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting 25 to 35 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Becoming mostly clear, with a few clouds in the St. Lawrence Valley late.  Cold.  Lows in the 20s, a few upper teens in the colder mountain valleys north.  Winds northwest near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph this evening, diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Sunday
text: A few morning clouds through the St. Lawrence and Champlain Valley, into the Adirondacks, then mostly sunny.  Not as windy and cold. Highs in the upper 40s to mid 50s.  Light winds east of the Green Mountains, turning to the south in the afternoon from the Green Mountains west near 10 mph, gusting to 25 mph near Lake Champlain.
